 MN: Two games, Krösche and the new San Siro – Cardinale’s week in Milan 
 By Ben Dixon - 27 October 2026, 16:00 
 Photos from the Bundesliga and Emmanuele Ciancaglini/Getty Images 
 This week could be a big one for AC Milan, so Gerry Cardinale has returned to Italy to spend it with the team, ensuring he’s present for key moments. 
 At this point, Cardinale’s presence in Milano is not strange. Maybe earlier this year it would have been, but no more. The American has committed to helping Milan himself, so his continued presence at Milanello and Casa Milan is a statement of that desire.

 After the win against Udinese, he stated he’d be in Italy all week , but what is on his agenda?
 Cardinale’s big week
 As MilanNews writes, this will be a key week for Cardinale. In terms of football, he oversaw the win in Udine and will be in town for the games against Bologna and the derby against Inter. Continued statements of his desire to support his team whenever and wherever possible.
 Photos by RedBird and Marco Luzzani/Getty Images Away from the pitch, though, his attention will turn to the management, where he hopes to intensify talks with Markus Krösche. The German has returned to the driving seat in the hunt for a Head of Football and a financial agreement has seemingly been reached. If the conditions can be agreed upon, the road to Krösche will open.
 Finally, maybe most importantly, he will be present on Thursday for the unveiling of the new San Siro in the Visconti Hall of the Sforza Castle. It’s a statement that marks a new era of the club, and it’s something he’s pushed for – personally – for years .
